analysis.summary: No shared Partner/Provider database collection exists; 'partner' identity is duplicated as free-text strings across Service.provider, Project.leader, Project.involvedPartners, and a client-only CONSORTIUM_PARTNERS constant — there is no single source of truth to refresh from the SECASSURED source.
analysis.details: The issue title bundles two distinct concepts that the codebase currently treats as separate free-text surfaces: (1) 'providers' = Service.provider, a per-service string already covered incidentally by the seed-data refreshes in #5/#6/#7, and (2) 'partners' = the hardcoded CONSORTIUM_PARTNERS array used for Project leader/involvedPartners selection, which is INTACT-project-specific today and would need to be refreshed to reflect SECASSURED consortium partners instead. Whether this issue needs a new first-class Partner entity (to fully satisfy 'each partner entry captures the details available in the source') or just refreshed string lists depends on how rich the SECASSURED source data actually is — this cannot be determined from the codebase alone.

pros: Only approach that can fully satisfy 'captures the details available in the source' if it has multiple fields per partner
cons: Highest effort/risk: new schema, migration of existing string references, new route+UI
Disproportionate to sibling issues #5/#6/#7 which are pure seed-data refreshes with no schema changes
Should only be chosen if the SECASSURED source is confirmed to have structured multi-field partner records
